from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentInfo(BaseModel):
    """Extracted facts from a single legal document to enable classification."""
    title: str = Field(description="The full title of the judgment document")
    stated_cause_of_action: str = Field(description="The specific cause of action (案由) explicitly named in the document")
    case_nature: str = Field(description="Broad legal nature: 'Civil', 'Administrative', 'Execution'")
    administrative_action_detail: str = Field(description="Specific administrative act type if applicable (e.g., Licensing, Revocation)")
    civil_dispute_detail: str = Field(description="Specific civil dispute type if applicable (e.g., Tort, Company, Contract)")
    involved_agencies: list[str] = Field(description="List of government agencies or entities involved")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Container for all extracted document instances."""
    documents: list[DocumentInfo]
